modern_education_technology.title: 英语挖矿大冒险 · 听音挖金
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击画面或按空格放钩，听发音寻找目标。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click or press Space to drop the hook; listen for the target.

modern_education_technology.title: 黄金矿工 · 单词矿场
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击或按空格放钩，P 键暂停。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click or press Space to drop the hook; press P to pause.

modern_education_technology.title: Unit 4 食物闯关小游戏
modern_education_technology.controls: 用上下方向键或屏幕按钮选择食物。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Use arrow keys or on-screen buttons to choose food.

modern_education_technology.title: Food Sorting Dash — Countable or Uncountable?
modern_education_technology.controls: 拖动食物到分类篮；也可先点食物再点篮子。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Drag food to a basket, or tap the food then its basket.

modern_education_technology.title: Food Fun! 食物记忆大挑战
modern_education_technology.controls: 选择挑战模式，按提示点击或拖动。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Choose a mode, then click or drag as instructed.

modern_education_technology.title: Eat Well · 我的英语小餐厅
modern_education_technology.controls: 按订单点击或拖动食物，可选择接力模式。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click or drag food to fill orders; a relay mode is available.

modern_education_technology.title: 食物单词飞行棋
modern_education_technology.controls: 2–3 人同屏，选择角色后轮流掷骰、答题。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: 2–3 players share a screen; choose characters, roll and answer in turn.

modern_education_technology.title: 食物打地鼠 · Food Whack-a-Mole
modern_education_technology.controls: 听发音，点击对应食物。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Listen and click the matching food.

modern_education_technology.title: Word Wheel - Spelling Game
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击转盘字母拼出目标单词。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click letters on the wheel to spell the word.

modern_education_technology.title: 食物单词塔防 - Food Words Tower Defense
modern_education_technology.controls: 先回答单词题，再点击地图放置防御塔。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Answer a word question, then click the map to place a tower.

modern_education_technology.title: 小青蛙洗澡 · 单词闸水流闯关
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击答案，通过单词关卡。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click an answer to complete each word challenge.

modern_education_technology.title: Escape Room: School Secret 校园密室逃脱 · 五重密室
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击场景线索，按提示解谜。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click scene clues and solve the puzzles.

modern_education_technology.title: 警察抓小偷 · Unit 2 单词
modern_education_technology.controls: 双人同屏，轮流掷骰并完成单词任务。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Two players share a screen; roll and complete word tasks in turn.

modern_education_technology.title: 女巫的毒药 Witch's Poison — 五年级英语课堂游戏
modern_education_technology.controls: 四组轮流选择词卡，按课堂规则竞赛。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Four teams take turns choosing word cards.

modern_education_technology.title: 拼词小达人 · Word Spell Game
modern_education_technology.controls: 依次点击字母，拼出目标单词。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click letters in order to spell the target word.

modern_education_technology.title: 小k历险记 · 羊皮卷寻宝图
modern_education_technology.controls: 跟随地图选择关卡并答题。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Follow the map, select a level and answer questions.

modern_education_technology.title: 英语单词消消乐 · 红蓝对抗版
modern_education_technology.controls: 红蓝两队同屏，点击配对词卡。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Red and blue teams share a screen and click matching cards.

modern_education_technology.title: 英语单词PK对战 · 比赛模式
modern_education_technology.controls: 两队同屏，点击答案进行单词竞赛。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Two teams share a screen and click answers to compete.

modern_education_technology.title: Food Word & Picture Matching Memory Game
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击翻牌，将食物单词与图片配对。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Flip cards to match food words with pictures.

modern_education_technology.title: Feelings单词记忆翻牌游戏
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击翻牌，配对情绪单词与表情。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Flip cards to match feelings with expressions.

modern_education_technology.title: 单词飞行棋 · Word Board Game
modern_education_technology.controls: 双人同屏，先猜拳决定顺序，再轮流完成任务。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Two players choose the first turn with rock-paper-scissors, then take turns.

modern_education_technology.title: 单词消消乐
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击词卡配对；联网 PK 需要双方网络连接。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click matching cards; online PK requires a connection for both players.

modern_education_technology.title: 🍉 英语切单词大闯关
modern_education_technology.controls: 按住鼠标或手指滑动，切中目标单词。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Hold and drag the mouse or swipe to slice the target word.

modern_education_technology.title: 单词切水果 · Unit1
modern_education_technology.controls: 按住鼠标或手指滑动切词，可选择对战。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Drag or swipe to slice words; a versus mode is available.

modern_education_technology.title: 五年级上册英语 · 单元闯关打地鼠双人PK
modern_education_technology.controls: 双人同屏，听题后点击对应地鼠。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Two players share a screen; listen and click the matching mole.

modern_education_technology.title: 单词扫雷 · Word Minesweeper
modern_education_technology.controls: 点击翻格，右键插旗；触屏可切换插旗模式或长按。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Click to reveal, right-click to flag; on touch, use flag mode or long-press.

modern_education_technology.title: Gold Miner · 单词寻宝
modern_education_technology.controls: 听目标发音，点击画面放钩寻宝。
modern_education_technology.controls_en: Listen for the target and click to drop the hook.
